Embeddings request against real OpenAI API

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":[\"Hello world\"],\"model\":\"openai/text-embedding-3-small\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OPENAI_API_KEY"] else { fatalError("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.embed(_req)
debugPrint(result.data)
```
